JSONKit 1.4, commit 82157634ca0ca5b6a4a67a194dd11f15d9b72835
https://github.com/johnezang/JSONKit

JSONKit.h and JSONKit.m copied unmodified, without a nested Git repository.
BSD license chosen; complete license text is retained at the top of each file.
Only compiled into Snow Leopard's cold guest-control tools because the native
10.6 Foundation has no NSJSONSerialization. Not used by host or GL hot paths.
